INTERVENOR HENDERCO LLC'S RESPONSE TO ONCOR AND LCRA'S
OBJECTIONS TO CERTAIN INTERVENORS' EXHIBITS LISTED IN ATTACHMENT A
OF SOAH ORDER NO. 30

Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Services Corporation (together,
"Applicants") filed objections to Intervenor Henderco, LLC's exhibits listed in Attachment A to
SOAH Order No. 30. Henderco, LLC (Intervenor No. 800) submits this response in support of
admitting its exhibits into evidence at the outset of the hearing on the merits. Contrary to the
Applicants' arguments, Henderco, LLC's Exhibits 1 and 2 were included with James Henderson’s
Direct Testimony filed on the Interchange on behalf of Henderco, LLC. See Item No. 3891. No
party objected to these exhibits at the time of filing. I addition, Henderco LLC’s exhibits were filed
on SOAH’s Kiteworks and Oncor’s Egnyte. Accordingly, Henderco LLC's exhibits should be
admitted into evidence. Date: June 7,2026

Respectfully submitted,

James Henderson
Henderco LLC
Managing Member
